Green Environment Youth Korea (GEYK) is a nonprofit youth organization that responds to the global climate crisis and works to create a sustainable future.

Our vision is to end the climate crisis in our generation. We make policy proposals, run campaigns, work with Korean and international networks to organize events, publish media such as newsletters, attend UN climate conferences, and hold follow-up events.

We’re seeking cohort 24 members to help find ways to tackle the climate crisis and build a sustainable future with GEYK.

Recruitment Schedule

  • Applications: February 6–18, 2026.
  • Shortlisted applicants notified: February 20, by individual email.
  • Interviews: February 21–24. We will try to arrange a convenient time with shortlisted applicants, but may need to assign a slot.
  • Final decisions: February 27.
  • New member orientation: Saturday, March 7, at 10 a.m. in Seoul. The venue will be announced later. Attendance is required to retain your place.

How to Apply

  1. Download and complete the GEYK Cohort 24 application form.
  2. Complete the Google Form.

For recruitment questions, send us a message on Instagram (@geykkorea) or email geykkorea@gmail.com.

Anyone passionate about climate action is welcome!
